newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduras consumer prices up 1.3 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Honduras consumer prices up 1.3 pct in June.

text.p: Honduran consumer prices rose 1.3 percent in June, slightly above the 1.2 percent in May but within the government's targets, the central bank said on Thursday.

Central Bank President Hugo Pino told reporters that inflation in the six months to the end of June was 8.6 percent, which he said strengthened chances of remaining within the year-end target of 16 percent.
"It's very likely we will stay within the target we had set of 15 or 16 percent," he said.
Inflation in 1996 was 24.8 percent, and in June last year it was 2.5 percent.
